ns2:course.label: Org Design and Environment
ns2:course.description: Understanding of complex organizations; particular attention to ways of dividing work, achieving coordination, and issues connected with change and adaptation. Prerequisite: BADM 310.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Accountancy or Finance or General Engineering or Industrial Engineering or Business or Supply Chain Management or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Business Process Management or Management or Systems Engineering and Design or Information Systems or Operations Management major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
